msg: If you can, remember which shape hat gnome brings you more mushrooms, and keep using that gnome until the mushrooms start to decrease in number. Switching to a different gnome won't always immediately increase the number of mushrooms collected though, but persevere.The colours also seem to have influence on the mushrooms collected but I was unable to remember both colours and shapes!Most importantly, don't forget to choose a gnome and press the space bar to actually collect the mushrooms, or the round *will* time out and you *will* miss a turn. Good luck!
